lines.zh: 我从土里钻出，一节一节上。
lines.en: I come up from the soil, segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，土被翻开。
lines.en: I slide over the ground, turning the soil.

lines.zh: 我在地上扭了一下，找准方向。
lines.en: I twist once on the ground to find my line.

lines.zh: 我顺着震动往你脚下爬。
lines.en: I crawl toward your feet, following the shaking.
I shift segment by segment, slowly.
I climb onto a stone and slide off.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边过，土翻起来。
lines.en: I pass your feet, and the soil churns.
The ground is soft where I've passed.

lines.zh: 我的身子一段段抬起来。
lines.en: My body lifts in sections.

lines.zh: 我在草丛里穿行，草倒下去。
lines.en: I move through the grass, and it falls flat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地钻进土里，又出来。
lines.en: I sink into the soil and come up again.
My tail is the last to pass.

lines.zh: 我绕过那块石头继续钻。
lines.en: I loop around that boulder and keep burrowing.
I push the soil into a mound.
I travel along the wall, body twisting.
I crawl up a tree, and it shakes.
I lie coiled in the soil, still.
Only one segment shows above ground.
I listen to footsteps above.
My body tightens and releases.
I'm waiting for someone to step here.
There are bugs in the soil; I ate two.
My segments are caked with mud.

lines.zh: 我把露出的那节立起来。
lines.en: I raise the segment showing above ground.

lines.zh: 我记得从地下往上看的光。
lines.en: I remember the light from below the ground.
I count the pairs of feet above.
I hold still, and wait.
I bury my body in shallow soil.
You're standing above me.
I show my head from the soil and look at you.
My segments move; you don't.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，底下是空的。
lines.en: The ground you stand on is hollow beneath.
My mouth is below, out of sight.
When you back off, I hear the soil shift.
The smell of sweat comes down through the soil.
I lift a little higher.

lines.zh: 你的影子压在我露出的那节上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my exposed segment.
I see you, and you're looking at me.
I pull a length of myself back into the soil.
A segment broke off.
I twist once and steady.

lines.zh: 我扭了扭，把断节接回去。
lines.en: I twist and fit the broken segment back.
I shudder, and mud falls.
I don't cry out; the soil speaks for me.
I sink my body into the wet soil.
My head hangs crooked; I slowly set it right.
There's a split along me.
I'm still in the soil, still moving.
The footsteps above stir me.
You're standing close; I can feel it.
The soil shakes; I know you're there.
I shift toward that small noise.
You step once; I lift a segment.
Something warm is above me.
I smell flesh.
I turn my head toward the sound.
Don't walk off; I'm half a length short.
I push upward slowly.
You step on me, and I sway.
I bump you from beneath the soil.
We collide, and dirt flies.

lines.zh: 你被我绊了一下，差点倒。
lines.en: I trip you, and you nearly fall.
I coil around your ankle.

lines.zh: 你的脚陷进我翻的土里。
lines.en: Your foot sinks into the soil I turned.

lines.zh: 我被踩扁了一节，又鼓起来。
lines.en: One segment is flattened, then swells back.
I retreat into the soil, only my head out.
One bump, and I change direction.
We part, and the soil still moves.
Another comes up out of the soil.
Her segments are finer than mine.
We coil together, and the soil turns.
She rests her head on me.
We burrow deeper together.
Her body is cool, and so is mine.

lines.zh: 我们不需要看，只靠震动。
lines.en: We don't need sight, only vibration.
Two worms, one ring of soil.
She digs down first; I follow.

lines.zh: 我们一起等上面的脚步。
lines.en: We wait together for footsteps above.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的靴子，往下拖。
lines.en: I bite your boot and pull down.

lines.zh: 我把地上的东西拖进土里。
lines.en: I drag the thing on the ground into the soil.
I swallow a lump of mud and spit it out.
I take a bug and eat it.
I drag off your dropped shield.
I push the stone aside.
I hold the arrowhead in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把土里的骨头翻出来。
lines.en: I turn a bone up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的披风，拉了一下。
lines.en: I bite your cloak and tug.
I hide an egg under the soil.
The soil above me is trampled firm.
The soil shook three times; I'm locked on.
I raise my head to look from below.
You stand right above me; good.
I begin to dig this way.
My body tightens segment by segment.
I straighten and break through the soil.

lines.zh: 这个位置我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I remember this spot exactly.
Walking away won't help; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 我选了这块土，下面是空的。
lines.en: I chose this soil; it's hollow below.
I came from underground.
When I move, the surface cracks.
My head points up, mouth open.
Count three, and I emerge.
I follow you beneath the soil.
A ridge in the soil; that's me.
You stop, and I stop.
I line my head up directly below.
You shifted your feet; I heard.
I rise slowly, not to startle you.
You're on stone; I'll wait.
The soil loosens more and more.

lines.zh: 土面上你的呼吸，我数得清。
lines.en: Through the soil I count your breaths.
Beneath the surface I take a bend.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，土也跟着动。
lines.en: You step back, and the soil moves with you.
Only a layer of soil between us.
I coil tighter.

lines.zh: 你在找地面，地面不在了。
lines.en: You look for solid ground; it's gone.
I burst from the soil and hit you.
I bite your leg.
I coil your foot and pull down.
I butt your knee.
I coil several segments around it.

lines.zh: 这一下从土底下冒出来。
lines.en: That came up from under the soil.
You fall, and soil puffs up.
I whip once and throw you off.
I bite and burrow back.
My segments roll over you.
The surface splits, and I come out.
I come up from deep, cool with it.
My segments emerge one by one.
The soil is soft here; easy going.
My first act is to turn the soil.
I hear sounds on the surface.
I coil under the tree, still.
The moment I emerge, the grass falls.
I've circled this area a long while.
I raise my head to see who's above.
The soil heats up; I dig deeper.
I fall and land in a tangle.

lines.zh: 水灌进土里，我动得很慢。
lines.en: Water floods the soil; I move slowly.

lines.zh: 气浪把土掀开，我露在外面。
lines.en: The blast throws the soil up, leaving me exposed.
An arrow sticks into one of my segments.
A light pierces the soil and pins me.

lines.zh: 土里没虫了，我越来越软。
lines.en: No bugs left in the soil; I soften.

lines.zh: 雷打进土里，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the soil, and I go numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有土，我埋不进去。
lines.en: No soil here to bury into.
